text:
anika: Heads-up — saw micro-oscillation in the canary for v2p3-int4 vs v2q4 this morning. traffic keeps flipping every ~5m even though latency and token cost look stable. hallucination_rate jumps ~1.8->3.1% then drops. anyone else seeing this? :thinking:

liam: yep saw the spike in the telemetry dashboard. believes it's the gating window being too short — we treat the metric as instantaneous so small bursts trigger fallback, then traffic snaps back.

jess: +1. short windows + no dwell time = oscillation. I think we should add smoothing + a min_dwell for any promotion/fallback decisions.

mike: Agreed. Also we should require two signals for auto-fallback (eg hallucination delta AND concordance drop) to avoid noisy single-metric flips.

anika: proposal: switch to exponential smoothing (half-life 15m) and min_dwell 10m, but keep a short smoke window for urgent severe regressions. If hallucination_rate delta > 2% AND concordance drops > 5% over smoothed windows -> immediate fallback.

liam: drafted a quick config snippet — will run as a pilot on 5% slice with shadow compare enabled:

```yaml
canary:
  slice: 0.05
  metric_window: 900s  # base window for raw aggregation
  smoothing:
    type: exp
    half_life: 900s    # 15 minutes
    min_dwell: 600s    # 10 minutes min dwell before flip
  fallback_rules:
    - metric: hallucination_rate
      delta_pct: 2
      require: [concordance_drop]
    - metric: concordance_drop
      delta_pct: 5
      require: [hallucination_rate]
    - metric: latency_p95
      delta_pct: 20
      immediate: true
```

jess: minor tweak — make the require condition logical AND (both must cross) not OR. also add randomized decision jitter +/-30s to avoid sync with other slices.

mike: +1 on jitter. Also add a cooldown: after an auto-fallback, block re-promote attempts for 30m unless manual override. That should prevent thrashing.

ops-bot: deploy-check: canary rules patch proposed by @liam, reviewer @jess. CI smoke passed.

anika: action items: liam -> apply pilot config to 5% slice and enable shadow compare for full compare metrics; jess -> update gate logic to require AND + jitter; mike -> add cooldown to promote flow; @oncall -> watch the canary for 2 hours and escalate if oscillation persists. I'll post a short follow-up after the 2h pilot. :eyes:
